issue_context.summary: ZoomIt visibly oscillates when the user scrolls to the bottom of its UI; the report supplies a concise repro but no screenshot, recording, or code-path evidence.
known_information: The report concerns ZoomIt on PowerToys 0.100.2 installed through auto-update.
The interaction is scrolling to the bottom of the ZoomIt UI.
The actual behavior is vertical jittering; the expected behavior is stable content.
A public follow-up corroborates the ZoomIt-only behavior but does not state its PowerToys version or display settings.
inferences: A scroll-boundary or layout/rendering feedback loop may be involved, but the affected screen and exact branch are unconfirmed.
issue_context.analysis: The report is sufficiently concrete for a maintainer to reproduce without asking the reporter to repeat the same steps. The next useful action is a local replay and code trace, not a generic information request.
initial_investigation: Read the full live issue body, labels, update timestamp, and discussion.
Checked the ZoomIt source tree and found multiple scrolling and UI-test surfaces; the short report does not identify which screen is affected.
No linked fix or duplicate was supplied by the live issue.

reproduce.title: Replay issue #50828
prerequisites: Use a clean ZoomIt launch with the default UI configuration.
steps: Open the ZoomIt page in PowerToys Settings.
Scroll continuously to the bottom of the page or settings surface.
Pause at the bottom and observe whether the content or bottom section oscillates vertically.
Repeat after reopening Settings, then compare a different module's scrollable Settings page at the same window size and scaling.
reproduce.expected_result: The bottom of the ZoomIt UI reaches a stable scroll position without visible jitter.
